name: kottakal-clinic
description: Kottakal Multispeciality Dental Clinic — clinic management & digital operations platform

scripts.check: pnpm format:check && pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm build
scripts.infra:up: docker compose up -d --wait postgres redis minio mailpit && docker compose run --rm minio-init
scripts.infra:reset: node scripts/confirm.mjs "This deletes ALL local Docker volumes for kmsdc (database, redis, files)." && docker compose down -v
